title: Tensor realization on strict quotient models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and arbitrary schemes, with independent site and coefficient universes. Use the actual coherent reduction/total-limit adjunction $S$, its system derived tensor and canonical reduction presentations [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], the completed integral operations on good flat-term K-flat representatives [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined], and a projection- and resolution-normalized Roos realization [def-sf-primitive-tensor-realization-data]. For every scheme $W$, reduction datum $S$ on $W$ and normalized Roos realization $\rho$ on $W$, there exists a natural isomorphism $r:K\widehat\otimes_W H\cong\mathcal L_W(S(K)\otimes S(H))$. It satisfies the predicate $\operatorname{TensorModel}(S,\rho,r)$ of [def-sf-primitive-tensor-realization-data]: simultaneous strict quotient representatives, their actual finite tensor components and all transitions, and the equality with the specified Roos realization on every pair of good complexes. No counit invertibility, beta comparison or beta naturality is asserted.

proof.text: Apply quotientSystemFlatModels to the actual coefficient ring map and use the reduction presentation of S. Its good and computes clauses give whole-system K-flat representatives of both reductions, with the canonical finite evaluation maps and quotient transitions. The system tensor model identifies their total tensor with the derived system tensor.

Restrict scalars to the completed ring. Apply flatRoosFunctorDescent to the tensor tower and compare its two descents using integralCompletedTensorComparison and the specified reduction presentations. Localization uniqueness on the product of good categories gives r; its representative equality is exactly TensorModel. Normalize by the given Roos resolution equation, which identifies comparisons on resolutions and hence all inputs.

theorem primitiveCounitTensorRealization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (ρ : PrimitiveCounit.RoosRealization l E W) :
    ∃ r : integralCompletedTensor l E W ≅
      S.reduction.prod S.reduction ⋙ S.systemClosed.tensor ⋙ coefficientSequenceLimit l E W,
      PrimitiveCounit.TensorModel l E W S ρ r
